notes: PAP reference G53/3217. Whole four-room apartment in the Lakanal-Strasbourg district of Tours, on the first floor of a three-storey building. The complete advert describes a large entrance with storage, separate fitted kitchen with removable glass partition, living room and balcony, three bedrooms with fitted storage, bathroom and private underground parking. It states that the apartment is through-plan with east-west exposure, has gas heating, is close to bus and tram service, and is available immediately. Annual condominium charges of EUR 1,700 and property tax of EUR 1,250 are exposed. The live text contains no tenant, lease, occupied-sale or delayed-vacancy wording. PAP exposed 10 property photos and a publication date of 23 September 2026.

PAP reference G53/2307. Whole five-room duplex with 99 m2 Carrez and 120 m2 floor area in central Le Mans near the Prefecture, arranged over the second and third/top floors of an older building. The complete advert describes four bedrooms and an office, bathroom, shower room, two WCs, parquet, exposed beams, two fireplaces, integrated bookcase and double glazing. It states that the dwelling is in very good condition with only optional refreshing, has no lift, balcony or private parking, and is a direct owner sale. DPE C and GES B are stated from an August 2026 assessment, with annual condominium charges of approximately EUR 500. The live text contains no tenant, lease, occupied-sale or delayed-vacancy wording. PAP exposed 12 property photos and a publication date of 22 September 2026.
